Original WGSL shaders, simulation, and vgpu renderer preserved.
React lifecycle adapted to standalone JavaScript. Transparent photographic overlay at 25% opacity; shardColor/accentColor #f97316, speed 0.87.
Pointer interactions and markers disabled; 30 FPS render cap; DPR capped at 1.25; pauses while hidden; disabled for reduced motion/transparency; photograph remains if WebGPU is unavailable.
